278609056.description: This angel wing calcite mineral specimen measures approximately 3x4x3.5 inches and weighs about 645.4 grams. The stone features a cream to light peach color with a porous, crystalline structure and natural, unpolished surface. Under ultraviolet (UV) light, it exhibits strong fluorescence, consistent with calcite. The specimen includes natural formations and a band of darker material near the base. It is in natural, unaltered condition with no visible damage, suitable for mineral collectors, educational use, or display.

Description
: Bring a piece of natural history into your collection with this unique limestone slab, featuring two visible fossilized fish. Perfect for educational displays or enthusiasts of paleontology, this specimen showcases intricate preservation in contrasting earthy and reddish-brown tones set within a solid, natural stone background.
The largest fish is clearly defined, while a second, smaller fish is also present on the slab's face, offering a detailed look at prehistoric aquatic life. Edges of the limestone show natural wear and a few rough spots, as expected from genuine fossil-bearing rock. This item adds character to any science-themed room or classroom and invites hands-on exploration of ancient natural wonders.
Condition: The slab shows surface wear, small chips, and some edge roughness but maintains excellent fossil visibility. All features are visible in the images provided. Great for collectors, educators, or as a unique decorative accent
